title: Unveiling the promoting effect of water on formaldehyde oxidation over Pt/TiO2: insights from H/D kinetic isotope effect, in situ FTIR, and DFT
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00541H, Paper
Lu Wang, Siyuan Zhang, Jukun Xiong, Meicheng Wen
Proposed mechanism of HCHO oxidation over Pt/TiO2 involves adsorption, transformation to formate, and CO2 formation, with water lowering energy barriers and facilitating OH regeneration for complete mineralization.
